scripts.build: cd react-app && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf public && cp -R react-app/dist public
scripts.verify:readonly-role: test -n "$WEB_READONLY_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'WEB_READONLY_DATABASE_URL is required' >&2; exit 1; }; psql "$WEB_READONLY_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/verify-readonly-web-role.sql
